agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of Rp 1,001,946,000,000 in net profit, with Rp 5 billion for general reserves and the remainder for data center expansion, with no dividends declared.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a Public Accounting Firm for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine the associated honorarium.
Agenda #4: The meeting set the 2026 Board of Commissioners' remuneration at Rp 4,030,765,731 and delegated the determination of Directors' remuneration to the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved pledging more than 50% of the company's net assets as collateral to secure new funding from third parties or banks.
Agenda #6: Lucas Adrian was appointed as a Director for a five-year term, and the updated board composition was confirmed with Otto Toto Sugiri as President Director.
